channel.title: Gotham Property Review (test fixture)
channel.description: Synthetic feed for exercising the news-insights PROPERTY and CONTACT branches.

item.title: Wayne Manor Sells for $47m in Gotham's Largest Estate Deal
item.description: The 42-acre estate on Gotham City's northern ridge has changed hands in the city's largest single-asset residential transaction in a decade.

item.title: Gotham City Office Vacancy Falls to Five-Year Low
item.description: Vacancy across Gotham City fell to 9.4 per cent in the third quarter, a fifth consecutive quarterly decline.

item.title: Bruce Wayne Returns as Chair of Wayne Enterprises
item.description: Bruce Wayne has been appointed chair with immediate effect, and has signalled a review of the group's Gotham City real estate holdings.

item.title: Wayne Tower Refurbishment Completes in Gotham City
item.description: The 51-storey tower on Gotham City's central axis has reached practical completion after a twenty-eight month programme.

item.title: North American Logistics Rents Climb 6% as Supply Pipeline Thins
item.description: Prime logistics rents across North America rose 6.2 per cent as the development pipeline contracted for a sixth consecutive quarter.

item.title: Wayne Enterprises Opens Metropolis Battery Plant
item.description: The group's first manufacturing investment in Metropolis will employ approximately 700 staff at full capacity.

item.title: Norwegian Salmon Exports Climb on Strong Asian Demand
item.description: Exports rose 11 per cent by volume in the third quarter on stronger demand from South Korea and Japan.
